findings.problem: The 10^40 figure appears from nowhere: the video never shows why random guessing needs so many tries (28 places, 27 choices each). The caption says '41-digit number' while the pill says '1.2 x 10^40', two notations for one idea, and the red bar next to a 4-pip green bar has no stated scale, so it reads as 'about 100x' rather than 'astronomically more'.
findings.fix: In the final beat (10.8 s on) show '27 x 27 x ... x 27 (28 times)' as a short row of 27 chips or '27^28' growing into the pill; make the caption and pill use the same notation ('1.2 x 10^40 tries'); mark the bar with a break symbol (//) or label it 'not to scale'.
findings.evidence: s4@13, s4@14.8: pill '1.2 x 10^40' with caption 'a 41-digit number of tries'; bars 40+ red pips vs 2-4 green pips.

findings.problem: The green dots beside CURRENT and TRY (the score: how many letters match) are never labelled, so a first-time learner cannot tell why 'CZT' is kept and 'CZQ' thrown away. The flowchart is squeezed into the right 35% and its curved 'not worse?' to 'throw away' arrow loops past the 'keep' pill. The lower 45% of the stage is empty.
findings.fix: Add a tiny '2 of 3 match' counter (28 px) under each row, or a bracket reading 'score = matching letters'; widen the layout so the flowchart sits under the letter rows or enlarge the rows to use the empty bottom half; use a straight elbow arrow for 'throw away'.
findings.evidence: s3@3 (CZQ red, dots unlabelled), s3@5.5; bottom of every s3 still is blank.

findings.problem: Caption says 'Better? Keep it' but the flowchart question reads 'not worse?' (the lecture rule is keep if not worse). Small mismatch for a careful reader.
findings.fix: Caption: 'Change one letter at random. Not worse? Keep it.'

findings.problem: The orange dots dropping into the jars are never explained: nothing says they are 20 parent picks. Percentage pills are only ~22 px on screen against the 28 px label rule and the falling dot overlaps the 47% pill. 'Bias' is never defined before 'weak bias' appears at the end.
findings.fix: Add a label '20 picks' with a small orange dot legend; enlarge the percentage pills to 28 px; start the first drop below the pill; change the final tag to 'weak bias: fitter, but nobody shut out' or define bias in the caption ('Bias = how strongly we favour the fit').
findings.evidence: s6@4 (dot over the 47% pill, small pills), s6@7 (20 unlabelled dots), s6@11.8.

findings.problem: For the first 5 s the recombine half of the stage is an empty box and the mutate panel sits half-width, leaving the right half dead. The mutation caption wraps to two lines, shifting the caption block and crowding the chip row, unlike every other scene. Two ideas on one stage both take their turn but the first panel never reduces to give the second focus.
findings.fix: Shorten the caption to one line ('Mutation: copy a parent, change one gene.'); either hide the recombine card until 5.2 s and centre the mutate card before then, or fill it with a ghost of the AAAAAA / BBBBBB parents.
findings.evidence: s7@1, s7@3.5 (two-line caption, empty right panel), s7@5.3.

findings.problem: The Recombine step is visually tangled: five or six purple loops arc from parent dots across the whole landscape and bunch up around the star, so the learner cannot see which two parents make which child; x-count tags (x4, x4, x2) pile into the star and the 'average' pill. The first step shows no numbers at all even though the caption says 'height is fitness'.
findings.fix: Draw only two or three clean arcs one after the other, each with a short 'child' dot at its end; move the x-tags to the side of the dots away from the star; in step 1 flash a '12%' to '95%' height read-out on two dots.
findings.evidence: s8@6 (purple loops tangled near the star), s8@3.8 (x4 label touching the star).

findings.problem: The six application tiles are only a pictogram plus a one-word label, so 'Identification', 'Control' or 'Simulation' mean nothing to a newcomer, and the lecture's real examples (NASA antenna, car shapes, spam, Top Gun) never appear. The first 5 s use only the top 45% of the stage, with the fitness-function score numbers (2, 4, 5) tiny and the scoring rule (green boxes counted) never stated; tiles then appear one by one on an otherwise empty stage.
findings.fix: Add a second, one-line label in each tile ('routes, timetables', 'antennas, car shapes', 'competing firms', 'fit a curve to data', 'robot, turbine', 'spam, diagnosis') at 28 px; enlarge the score numbers to 28 px with a caption such as 'score = green boxes'; scale the score demo to use the empty lower half.
findings.evidence: s9@1, s9@4 (small numbers 2 / 4, empty bottom), s9@7 (only three tiles, no examples).

findings.problem: Recap tile 3 shows binary digits only about 20 px high (below the 28 px rule) and, with the three cards, uses only the top 55% of the stage until the button appears at the end, leaving the bottom half empty. The recap leaves out the generation loop (score, select, recombine, mutate, replace) and the six areas, although the boss quiz tests both; card 2 'Population, weak selection, mutation' omits recombination.
findings.fix: Enlarge the cards to fill the stage (about 190 px high each) with 28 px digits; add a fourth card for the loop (small Score to Replace arrow row) or fold it into card 2; mention 'recombination (optional)'.
findings.evidence: s10@6 and s10@8.8 (empty lower half, tiny digits in card 3).

findings.problem: The three pictograms are small (330 x 150) and the right 40% of every row is empty, so the opening scene looks sparse and the animations are hard to read at video size. The brain and ant rows never show what the two systems actually do: the green edge colouring is the only hint, and nothing links ants to 'scent' except the caption. The row is called 'Collective behaviour' but the caption says 'Ants', so the names do not match.
findings.fix: Scale each pictogram about 1.4x, or move the tags to the right with larger text; make the ant caption 'Collective behaviour: ants leave scent; short trails get more.'; label the row 'Collective behaviour (ants)'.
findings.evidence: s2@7, s2@9.5 (wide empty area right of the tags, small pictograms).

findings.problem: 'No one is in charge' (final caption) is not shown by anything on screen; the picture at that moment is just the orange highlight of Evolution.
findings.fix: Add a small crossed-out boss icon (SVG) beside the three rows at 10 s, or drop the sentence from the caption.

findings.problem: The three-step ingredient tracker (Population / Selection + mutation / Recombination) appears at 5.8 s with no introduction, and the 200-run grids give no hint that each small square is one run.
findings.fix: Give the tracker a 'Lecture recipe:' label when it first appears; add a legend 'one square = one run' under the grids.

findings.problem: Every scene from 3 onwards starts with about 0.3 s of a totally blank stage (only the faded kicker) after a full previous frame, which feels like a flicker at each cut.
findings.fix: Have the first stage element fade in from t = 0.05 or overlap scene transitions with a 0.2 s fade of the incoming figure.
